title: Nava Manmadhudu
desc: Tamizh investigates the true reasons behind his father's suicide. His investigation exposes buried secrets, leading him to confront betrayal and fight for justice.

title: Maari 2
desc: Maariyappan, a gangster, is confronted by Gangadhar Beeja, a rival. While he strives to defeat him, he attempts to cope with his son's questionable behaviour.

title: Pokiri
desc: Krishna, a police officer, disguises himself as a thug and joins the mafia in order to wipe out the underworld. Meanwhile, he falls in love with Shruti, an aerobics teacher.

title: Baapu
desc: Debt-ridden farmer Mallanna faces an impossible moral dilemma when his wife proposes a shocking solution to their financial crisis.

desc: Subramanyam, a money-minded man, comes across Seetha, a woman living alone in the US after being abandoned by her boyfriend. Subsequently, he decides to help her after seeing her plight.

title: Sindhooram
desc: Bulliraju, a trainee police officer, intervenes with corrupt officials and ends up becoming the leader of a terror gang.

title: Addiction Killer
desc: The host presents a wide range of Ayurvedic remedies for addiction that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.

title: Calvary Darshanam
desc: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of Christ and encourages the followers to take the path of spirituality.

title: Bhaagamathie
desc: Chanchala, an IAS officer, is imprisoned in a haunted house for interrogation. However, things take an unexpected turn when she gets possessed by a spirit.

title: Nirmala Convent
desc: Samuel, the son of a poor farmer, falls in love with Shanti, who belongs to an elite class. When Samuel proposes to Shanti, her father asks him to attain popularity and he accepts the challenge.

title: Daaku Maharaaj
desc: A brave thief fights to survive and claim his territory. However, he battles powerful enemies, aiming to become a leader without a real kingdom.

title: I
desc: A bodybuilder and successful model plans revenge after his enemies inject him with a substance that deforms his body.

title: K-Ramp
desc: A rich businessman, Krishna, sends his wayward son, Kumar, to Kerala in order to reform him. There, Kumar falls for Mercy, a girl with PTSD and suicidal tendencies.

title: Bharat Ane Nenu
desc: Bharat, a graduate from Oxford, is forced to take up his father's position as the chief minister after his sudden death. He tries to reform the corrupt society but faces obstacles from his enemies.
